Now I have all the information needed to produce the review. Let me compile my analysis.

{"lens":"completeness_governance","summary":"WP-SCP-024 slice 024B delivers all seven plan-doc §6 scope items (scaffolder, adopter-wrapper template, --restore mode, check-invocation-log-entry.sh covering all four CI behaviours, scaffolder tests, --restore evidence path, D-044). No silent descope detected. D-044 is correctly filed and reserved. ADOPT-001 §12.8 is placed between §12.7.15 and §13; §12.7 Reference line gains D-044; §12.8 Reference line names invariant 7, D-044, D-035, and §12.7. STATUS.md carries a 2026-05-09 024B row with correct content; two 2026-05-09 entries co-exist in correct sequence. TF-024-FUP-ACC-INSTALL-TARGET-REPO-001 is named in both the Cohort cascade gate subsection and STATUS.md tracked-forward items. TF-024B-002 (--restore round-trip evidence) is properly marked pending and merge-blocking. FLA references are absent as a precondition (invariant 4 satisfied). ACC notifications dir is correctly deferred to 024C kickoff. Plan-doc invariants 1, 3–6, 8–10 are all satisfied in the shipped artefacts. One MAJ completeness failure: the new CI workflow will fail-closed on the 024B PR's own DISPATCH-NOTE because its cascade-status line is backtick-wrapped commentary rather than a bare parseable field, making the CI-green acceptance criterion unmeetable without a manual bypass. Four MIN and two nit findings address documentation inconsistencies, a silent schema-validation skip path, stale sequencing table, and adopter-facing internal-jargon in the PR-body template.","findings":[{"id":"MAJ-CG-001","severity":"MAJ","claim":"check-invocation-log-entry.yml will fail-closed on the 024B PR's own DISPATCH-NOTE, making the 'CI green' acceptance criterion unmeetable without a manual bypass that leaves no audit record.","evidence":"DISPATCH-NOTE.md line 9: '`cascade-status:` not applicable — this slice does not onboard a cohort adopter' (backtick-inline). The workflow awk pattern `docs/reviews/WP-SCP-024/[^/]+/DISPATCH-NOTE.md` matches docs/reviews/WP-SCP-024/024B/DISPATCH-NOTE.md; python3 re.findall(r'^cascade-status:\\s+([a-z-]+)\\s*$', text, re.M) yields 0 matches; check-invocation-log-entry.sh exits 1 (FAIL-CLOSED). No workflow carve-out exempts the 024B slice itself. Test case15b confirms 'cascade-status: not applicable' (bare) also yields 0 matches.","impact":"The 024B PR fails its own CI gate. Resolving without a code fix requires force-merge or disabling the required check—contradicting the D-040 single-operator self-merge acceptance criterion and the plan-doc §6 CI-green gate. Establishes a bypass precedent for the safety-enforcement script that is architecturally inappropriate.","mitigation":"Add a bare field `cascade-status: not-applicable` (hyphen, no backticks) to the 024B DISPATCH-NOTE AND add `not-applicable` as a recognised exit-0 (skip-enforcement) value in check-invocation-log-entry.sh alongside the fail-closed catch for unrecognised values. Document the carve-out in D-044 so future scaffolding slices follow the same pattern."},{"id":"MIN-CG-001","severity":"MIN","claim":"ADOPT-001 §12.7.1 CODEOWNERS example still references `policy-check.yml` not `policy-check-wrapper.yml`, creating immediate documentation rot once cascade adopters onboard on the canonical wrapper filename.","evidence":"ADOPT-001-project-onboarding.md line 814-816: `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml @your-team-owners`. The scaffolder emits `policy-check-wrapper.yml` (scaffold-downstream.sh line 170: `wrapper_path=\"${WORKFLOWS_DIR}/policy-check-wrapper.yml\"`). The carve-out note at line 795-804 explains the naming situation but does not update the CODEOWNERS example line itself.","impact":"Cascade adopters following §12.7.1 verbatim will protect `policy-check.yml` in CODEOWNERS, leaving their actual wrapper file (`policy-check-wrapper.yml`) unprotected. TF-024B-003 tracks the `--wrapper-path` follow-on but does not track the CODEOWNERS example staleness, so this gap has no closure path named.","mitigation":"Update the §12.7.1 CODEOWNERS example to `.github/workflows/policy-check-wrapper.yml @your-team-owners` or add a conditional note: 'If using the cascade-scaffolded wrapper, replace policy-check.yml with policy-check-wrapper.yml here.'"},{"id":"MIN-CG-002","severity":"MIN","claim":"Scaffolder test schema-validation has a silent SKIP exit path when pyyaml is absent, making the 'schema-validates emitted wrapper' acceptance criterion conditionally satisfied only when pyyaml is installed.","evidence":"tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh line 129-133: `except ImportError as exc: raise SystemExit(\"SKIP: pyyaml not installed — install it to run YAML lint checks\")`. SystemExit without an integer arg defaults to exit-code 1 in Python—but the outer shell harness uses `run_expect_exit 0` for this block implicitly via the inline python3 call. The DISPATCH-NOTE AC says 'schema-validates emitted wrapper against canonical shape'. In a CI environment lacking pyyaml, the YAML lint check silently skips.","impact":"The schema-validation AC is not machine-enforceable without pyyaml pre-installed. If the operator runs tests in a clean venv, wrapper shape regressions (e.g. a missing `permissions:` block) are not caught. The test harness does not install pyyaml as part of setup.","mitigation":"Add pyyaml to a test requirements file and install it in the test step, or change the SystemExit to exit 1 (hard-fail) so the CI runner surface knows the check was skipped rather than silently treating it as a pass."},{"id":"MIN-CG-003","severity":"MIN","claim":"DISPATCH-NOTE Sequencing table (Phase 5) and version line are stale: 'fix-rounds 1-5 complete; R6 underway' when fix-round-6 has been committed and this is the seventh review pass.","evidence":"DISPATCH-NOTE.md Sequencing table row Phase 5: '5 rounds complete; R6 underway 🔄'. Git log shows commits 'fix-round-6: missing CI workflow wiring + 5 MAJ closed' (1545829) and 'fix-round-5: 5 unique MAJ closed (0 CRIT)' (1ec0d6a). Version line at DISPATCH-NOTE end: 'v0.4 — fix-rounds 1-5 complete; R6 underway'. This current dispatch is the R7 (third completeness_governance pass per exec log prefix r3-completeness_governance).","impact":"Operators reviewing merge-readiness cannot rely on the Sequencing table to determine the actual review-round state. Not a blocking failure per the lens instruction ('NOT a fail item'), but inaccurate closure documentation reduces traceability.","mitigation":"Update Sequencing table Phase 5 status to '6 rounds complete; R7 underway' and version line to 'v0.5 — fix-rounds 1-6 complete; R7 underway' before self-merge."},{"id":"MIN-CG-004","severity":"MIN","claim":"CASCADE-PR-BODY.md template embeds SCP-internal plan-doc references (Invariant 1, invariant 9, D-031, T-024-04, T-024-09, TF-023E-002) in the adopter-facing PR body, which are opaque to adopter-side reviewers who have no access to the plan-doc.","evidence":"scaffold-downstream.sh lines 189-209: CASCADE-PR-BODY.md template text includes 'invariant 9 and D-031 both acknowledge', 'T-024-09 expects roughly 2-5 minutes', 'T-024-04 and the D-036 deprecation ramp', 'TF-023E-002 defers the wrapper-shape change'. Adopter reviewers see a PR body with internal SCP decision-tracking IDs that link to no public document. Plan-doc §5.3 specifies the PR body should cover cost estimate + bus-factor-1 + version-skew + scorecard-emit opt-in—the content is present but embedded in jargon.","impact":"Adopter reviewers cannot interpret the references and may dismiss the disclosures as SCP-internal noise. The bus-factor-1 and consent disclosures that invariants 1 and 9 require to be surfaced to adopters are present but partially obscured. Plan-doc §5.2 item (1) says the PR body should cover cost estimate and bus-factor-1 disclosure—the substance is there but in a form that serves authors more than readers.","mitigation":"Replace internal reference shorthand with plain-English equivalents: e.g. 'Estimated CI cost is ~2-5 min on ubuntu-24.04 (under 10% of typical adopter CI)' instead of 'T-024-09 expects...'; 'This cascade is operated by a single maintainer with no bus-factor-1 review separation' instead of 'invariant 9 and D-031 both acknowledge'. Retain D-NNN references in DISPATCH-NOTE where they belong; the adopter PR body is a different audience."},{"id":"nit-CG-001","severity":"nit","claim":"TF-024B-001 closure is described as 'implicitly closed by fix-round-1's --restore extension rewriting the case-pattern region' without a linking commit SHA or shellcheck re-run evidence, weakening traceability.","evidence":"STATUS.md Tracked-forward items from 024B line: 'TF-024B-001 (closed): pre-existing shellcheck SC2221+SC2222 warnings on enable-required-check.sh:235 (commit 373bcd29 / slice 020G 2026-04-30) — implicitly closed by fix-round-1's --restore extension rewriting the case-pattern region; shellcheck on enable-required-check.sh now exits 0.' No shellcheck exit-0 run artifact is captured.","impact":"Implicit closure without a verification artifact means a future reader cannot confirm shellcheck actually passes; if the fix-round-1 rewrite later regresses, this TF has no baseline evidence to detect it.","mitigation":"Add a note: 'Verified: shellcheck enable-required-check.sh exits 0 as of commit <fix-round-1-sha>'. Alternatively capture shellcheck output to a doc artefact alongside the scope-check log files already in 024B's review dir."},{"id":"nit-CG-002","severity":"nit","claim":"DISPATCH-NOTE version line and status string at the document foot ('Status: v0.4 — fix-rounds 1-5 complete; R6 underway') duplicate the Sequencing table's stale state and will not auto-update before self-merge.","evidence":"DISPATCH-NOTE.md final line: '**Status:** v0.4 — fix-rounds 1-5 complete; R6 underway; pending operator step 7 `--restore` demo and self-merge.' This is a second staleness surface beyond the Sequencing table (addressed in MIN-CG-003). Both the version and fix-round count must be manually updated.","impact":"Minimal — two stale fields rather than one. Combined, they give a reader two data points that under-count actual review rounds, slightly eroding confidence in the slice's closure documentation completeness.","mitigation":"Update to 'Status: v0.5 — fix-rounds 1-6 complete; R7 in progress; pending operator step 7 --restore demo and self-merge.' Ideally this and the Sequencing table (MIN-CG-003) are updated in the same commit."}]}
